digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and container scope inheritance
propositions: Live declared-none children must be neutral in scope inheritance: they contribute no paths and do not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation.
Any live undeclared child poisons child inheritance, preventing path inheritance and blocking all-none promotion, unless parent declares paths or none explicitly.

A parent declared none or owned paths retains precedence and is never promoted to none by all-none children; all-none scope is signed only when at least one live child exists and every live child is authenticated none.

Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshots without network fetches, computing child impact from initial_generation.relation_snapshot.child_ids and ticket_states_by_id.
P9 must pass leaves and containers with only declared children (none or paths), advise only live undeclared children as poisoners, and offer both path declaration and --none as truthful remedies.
